messages:
lina-mobile: FYI I'm seeing stalled Retrofit calls on Pixel 7 (API 33) when we enable HTTP/2 + pingInterval on the client. Calls never return or cancel until app process is killed. Repro with sample app polling embeddings every 150ms. cc @jasper-sdk

jasper-sdk: interesting. you mean call.cancel() does nothing? or response callback never invoked?

lina-mobile: call.cancel() is invoked by the lifecycle onStop, but the coroutine awaiting the suspend call keeps hanging. No exception, no callback. stack shows waiting on Okio read.

nate-infra: we've seen similar with `pingInterval` interacting with connection health checks and HTTP/2 pings causing frames to be in-flight. Can you paste your OkHttp config?

lina-mobile: config snippet: 
```
val client = OkHttpClient.Builder()
  .pingInterval(Duration.ofSeconds(15))
  .connectionPool(ConnectionPool(5, 5, TimeUnit.MINUTES))
  .build()
val retrofit = Retrofit.Builder()
  .baseUrl(BASE)
  .client(client)
  .addConverterFactory(MoshiConverterFactory.create())
  .addCallAdapterFactory(CoroutineCallAdapterFactory()) // uses enqueue under the hood
  .build()
```

jasper-sdk: aha. CoroutineCallAdapterFactory enqueues calls and bridges to suspend. There are known edge cases where cancellation doesn't propagate cleanly if the CallAdapter wraps without wiring timeout/cancel correctly. We recommend using Retrofit's built-in suspend support (Kotlin `suspend` functions) instead of 3rd-party adapters.

lina-mobile: switching to suspend functions helped but still saw hang under heavy multiplexing. The cause looked like the ping frames plus in-flight streams keeping the connection busy; the library's cancel path didn't interrupt read() when a ping is pending. On API 33 emulator it reproduced reliably.

nate-infra: couple of options: 1) set pingInterval to zero to disable, 2) call `call.timeout().cancel()` in addition to `call.cancel()`, 3) use a dedicated Dispatchers.IO with proper coroutine cancellation handling, or 4) use a separate low-level OkHttpClient for auth/refresh/pings.

jasper-sdk: add that `call.timeout().cancel()` is only in OkHttp 4.10+; we should check min supported. Also we can add an EventListener around Call to log cancellation propagation to help repro.

lina-mobile: tried disabling pingInterval -> stable. Verified `call.timeout().cancel()` also forces the coroutine to throw. For our SDK quickstart we should document: avoid enabling pingInterval by default for mobile clients that do frequent short polling; prefer shorter keepalive or disable pings.

jasper-sdk: agreed. I'll add a doc note in the Android SDK best-practices page and update the sample app to use suspend functions rather than CoroutineCallAdapterFactory. Also open PR to add a small utility `OkHttpCancellationKt.cancelAndTimeout(call: Call)` that calls both cancel and timeout.cancel.

triangle-bot: created issue REDWOOD-DEVEX-349: "Android: guidance for pingInterval, coroutine call cancellation, and Retrofit adapters" and linked to PR draft #1458.

lina-mobile: cool. can we add a short test in devex smoke that runs polling on emulator API 33 with pingInterval enabled so we avoid regressions?

nate-infra: scheduled `devex/android-ping-cancel-smoke` job. will run on emulator API 33 and 30.

jasper-sdk: thumbs up. will push the doc + sample change later today. thanks for catching this, lina. :rocket:
